understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid through every level, modify the carried piece so its shape, color, and rotation matched each goal, then step onto the matching goal cells to activate and complete them.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs stamina, while blocked moves waste a turn and stamina without changing position. Shape, color, and rotation modifier tiles cycle or change the corresponding piece attributes; goals activate only when all three attributes match. Stamina reaching zero costs a life and restores maximum stamina, and losing all lives ends the game. The current level advances after all goals are completed.
